acceptance.given: Package A scope is evaluated against the frozen requirements and declared deliverables before implementation validation.

oracle.expected: The evaluated Package A artifacts and implementation contain none of the excluded capabilities, systems, analyses, installation behaviors, or mandatory review requirements.
oracle.observable: A structural scope assertion over Package A artifacts, declarations, and implementation paths reports no excluded additions during the validation phase.

acceptance.then: The scope assertion passes only when every named exclusion remains absent from Package A and its declared implementation surface.
acceptance.when: Run the Package A scope test against the authored standard, policy, validator, schemas, and declared test fixtures.

affected_subjects: Package A explicit negative scope list
slice_hint.behavior_change: Package A authoring and validation artifacts preserve the frozen exclusion boundary and reject any declared or implemented addition from that list.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Remove only the Package A scope artifacts or revert their versioned declarations; preserve existing Skill-contract and Skill-input protocols and historical evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frozen negative scope is carried from requirements into the published standard and enforced by the local structural validation test.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The Package A scope test completes with a structured pass and no excluded capability, system, analysis, installation behavior, or mandatory review requirement found in the declared Package A surface.
